native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Impacket WmiExec Remote Execution
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  endpoint.os = 'Windows' AND
  event.type = 'Process Creation' AND
  src.process.parent.name = 'WmiPrvSE.exe' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'cmd.exe ' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' /Q ' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' /c ' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains ' 1>' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains '\\127.0.0.1' AND
  src.process.commandLine contains ' 2>&1'
) AND NOT (
  src.process.user contains:anycase 'cyberhawk' OR
  src.process.user contains:anycase 'Risc.Assessment'
)
